impact: `_generate_locked` prints the candidate path before its sole production caller has exited the candidate lease or performed the final root-identity check. If lease release or that final check fails, `generate` deletes the completed candidate and raises, but stdout has already emitted a success-shaped path to a now-missing candidate. I read both complete generation functions and grepped all callers; no outer layer retracts or delays this output.
title: [premature-success-reporting] `_generate_locked` prints the candidate path before its sole production caller h
